items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: he was there at one time when he had Dootsie Williams in the band; and Joe Lewis was playing guitar.

ctx.x: Right. So I don't know the way I was running around, because I was a maverick; I would play every place, you know -- any place. So that's why it is hard for me to tell you when I was at the Alabam, but I must have worked at the Alabam 5 different times. I worked there with Baron Morehead's band, I worked there with Lorenzo Flanoy's band -- he was there at one time when he had Dootsie Williams in the band; and Joe Lewis was playing guitar. Those are some of the guys I can remember.

Then I played there when Curtis Mosby had the band because at the time, they were in kind of bad shape, and they wanted me to play, and I understood the musicians were not getting paid regularly, right? And so I made my deal that I would play, but the girl at the boxoffice had to pay me every night before I played, you know, so I made my own deals.
